Spicy Beef Burrito
By: sevgi
Published: Saturday, May 15, 2010 - 8:45am

Ingredients




Corn Tortillas
1 pound Beef, cut into strips
2 Red Hot Chilis
Handful of Cilantro
1 Avocado
2 Green Onions
1 Garlic, minced
1 small tomato, diced
1 teaspoon Vegetable Oil
Hot Sauce- Optional

Preparation

1 Season the beef strips with salt and pepper. 2 Dice up the tomatoes, red chilis, green onions. 3 Chop up the cilantro. 4 Mince the garlic. 5 Peel the avocado and place in a bowl. Smash it up. 6 In a pan, add a touch of vegetable oil, cook up the beef strips. 7 Meanwhile, put the corn tortillas in the microwave, heat up for about 1 minute. 8 To serve: Spread the avocado onto the corn tortillas. Add the beef strips and the rest of the ingredients. 9 Add hot sauce if desired.

About


Here is a simple beef burrito recipe. You can use any kind of beef that you like, steaks work great. This recipe is just an idea of how little amount of ingredients go a long way. The avocado adds a lot of flavor. You can even switch this recipe up by using chicken instead of beef.
